<!-- absorbed from .github-old — verify still applies -->

## Process

1. Gather domain, triggers, use cases, references, and whether scripts are needed.
2. Draft a concise `SKILL.md`; split detailed references beyond roughly 100 lines.
3. Review structure, terminology, examples, and trigger accuracy.

Descriptions must state what the skill does and when to use it, remain under 1024 characters, and use third-person wording. Add scripts only for deterministic repeated operations. Keep links one level deep and verify the checklist after drafting.
